answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using trust-graph routing inside an isolated credit lagoon. An admission wharf validates new agents by tracing transitive payment channels from trusted seeds, bounding aggregate flow so rogue propagation collapses into a narrow plume. This forces an attacker to expend scarce, non-forgeable endorsement capacity from honest peers per identity. However, strict capacity bottlenecks penalize honest newcomer agents that lack established social ties.
